title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer regional failover and backoff hysteresis
author: Priya Kapoor
description: Fixes a production race condition in the SLO enforcer that caused backoff/hysteresis counters to persist across regional failover transitions and resulted in thrashing between regions under transient load. Root cause: an ordering bug in the enforcer's in-memory checkpointing path and insufficient isolation of region-scoped counters during the failover handshake. This PR introduces deterministic ordering for checkpoint writes, ensures region-scoped counter isolation in the enforcer store, and adds a short-lived hysteresis grace window during failover to prevent immediate retriggering. Also includes targeted unit and integration tests that reproduce the original thrash scenario, plus additional metrics and tracing hooks for post-deploy verification. The change is guarded behind a runtime flag (slo.enforcer.regional_hysteresis=true) to allow staged rollout and immediate rollback if needed. No API changes.
